obligations.text: Establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system.
Develop the system using training, validation and testing data sets that meet the data quality criteria.
Draw up and keep up to date technical documentation before placing the system on the market or putting it into service.
Ensure the system technically allows automatic recording of events (logs) over its lifetime.
Design the system to be sufficiently transparent for deployers to interpret and use its output.
Accompany the system with instructions for use containing the required information for deployers.
Design the system so natural persons can effectively oversee it while it is in use.
Ensure an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity throughout the lifecycle.
Carry out the conformity assessment based on internal control (Annex VI), with no notified body involved.
Register yourself and the system in the EU database before placing it on the market or putting it into service.

key_facts: The tool screens and ranks job applicants' CVs.
It shortlists the top candidates for recruiters.
to_confirm: Confirm the tool is placed on the market or used in the EU, or that its output is used in the EU.
Confirm whether you are the provider (you built it) and whether any customer deployers will rebrand or substantially modify it.
Confirm the shortlisting is not purely a narrow procedural task. Ranking candidates is profiling, so the Art 6(3) derogation is unlikely to apply.

obligations.text: Design and develop the chatbot so shoppers are informed they are interacting with an AI system, unless that is obvious to a reasonably well-informed, observant and circumspect person.

key_facts: Customer-service chatbot on an e-commerce website
Answers shopper questions in natural language
Interacts directly with shoppers
to_confirm: The chatbot only answers shopper questions and does not make decisions such as credit, eligibility or pricing assessments on individuals.
Whether the chatbot also generates synthetic text content that triggers further marking duties.

obligations.text: No mandatory obligations apply. You may take measures to ensure AI literacy of staff operating the system, and you may follow voluntary codes of conduct.

key_facts: AI spam filter
Sorts incoming company email into inbox or junk
to_confirm: The filter is used only to sort email. It is not used to evaluate or monitor employees, or for any other Annex III purpose.

obligations.text: Establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system.
Develop the model using training, validation and testing data sets that meet the data quality criteria.
Draw up and keep up to date technical documentation, containing at least the Annex IV elements, before placing on the market or putting into service.
Ensure the system technically allows automatic recording of events (logs) over its lifetime.
Design the system to be sufficiently transparent for deployers to interpret and use its output.
Accompany the system with instructions for use containing the required information for deployers.
Design the system so natural persons can effectively oversee it while it is in use.
Achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity, and keep it consistent throughout the lifecycle.
Complete the internal-control conformity assessment procedure (Annex VI) before placing on the market or putting into service.
Register the provider and the system in the EU database before placing on the market or putting into service.

key_facts: The model scores loan applicants' creditworthiness.
The bank uses the score to decide who gets a loan.
to_confirm: Confirm the system scores natural persons (individual applicants) and not only businesses.
Confirm the system is not used solely to detect financial fraud.

obligations.text: Do not place on the market, put into service or use AI systems that evaluate or classify people over time based on social behaviour or personal characteristics, where the resulting social score leads to detrimental treatment in unrelated social contexts or treatment that is unjustified or disproportionate; no exception applies to this described use.

key_facts: Government system gives each citizen a trustworthiness score
The score is based on everyday behaviour
The score is used to grant or deny access to public services
to_confirm: Confirm that the behavioural data comes from contexts unrelated to the public services where access is denied, or that the denial is disproportionate. Either condition is enough for the prohibition to apply, and both are likely met here.

Develop the system using training, validation and testing data sets that meet the data quality criteria.

Ensure the system technically allows automatic recording of events (logs) over its lifetime.

Register the provider and the system in the EU database before placing on the market or putting into service.

key_facts: The AI system evaluates students' exam answers
It assigns grades
The grades decide whether students progress to the next year
to_confirm: Confirm the system is used in an educational or vocational training institution, as the description implies.
Confirm whether a teacher reviews or can override the grades, which matters for the human oversight design.

obligations.text: Establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system for the system.
Develop the system using training, validation and testing data sets that meet the data quality criteria.
Draw up and keep up to date technical documentation before placing on the market or putting into service, containing at least the Annex IV elements.
Ensure the system technically allows automatic recording of events (logs) over its lifetime.
Design the system to be sufficiently transparent for deployers to interpret and use its output.
Accompany the system with instructions for use containing the required information for deployers.
Design the system so natural persons can effectively oversee it while it is in use.
Design the system to achieve appropriate accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity, performing consistently throughout its lifecycle.
Carry out the conformity assessment based on internal control (Annex VI), with no notified body involvement.
Register yourself and the system in the EU database before placing it on the market or putting it into service.

key_facts: The AI assesses asylum seekers' applications
It flags a risk level for each applicant
The output goes to border officials
to_confirm: Confirm the system is used by or on behalf of competent public authorities (e.g. border or asylum authorities).
Confirm the use is permitted under relevant Union or national law, as Annex III(7) applies only in so far as it is.

obligations.text: As provider, ensure the app's video outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated.
As deployer, disclose that the deep fake video content has been artificially generated or manipulated.

key_facts: The app generates realistic AI videos of real public figures
The videos show them saying things they never said
The videos are used for advertising campaigns
to_confirm: Whether the public figures have consented. The Act does not address this, but other EU law may apply, such as personality, image, data protection and advertising law.
Whether any campaign content is used to manipulate people in a way that could engage the Art 5 prohibitions, for example by materially distorting behaviour.
Whether any content is evidently artistic, satirical or fictional, since that would limit the form the disclosure must take.

rows.clarifying_question: What is the tool's specific intended purpose, meaning what task does it perform, what data does it process, and (if it produces scores, rankings or recommendations about people) how is its output used and who acts on it?

obligations.text: Ensure the generator's image and text outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated, using effective, interoperable, robust and reliable technical solutions as far as technically feasible.

key_facts: The system generates marketing images and ad copy from a text brief
The output is for the company's social media
to_confirm: Whether you are the provider of the generator (building it) or only a deployer using a third-party tool. The marking duty falls on the provider.
Whether any images depict realistic people, places or events that could count as a deep fake. If so, the deployer must disclose that they are AI-generated (Art 50(4)).
Whether the ad copy is published to inform the public on matters of public interest. Ordinary marketing copy normally is not.
Whether the tool only assists with standard editing or doesn't substantially alter the input. The marking duty doesn't apply in that case.

key_facts: Internal research model trained and tested in a lab only
Never placed on the market
Not used on real users
to_confirm: The model is never placed on the market or put into service, including internal deployment for real use.
No testing in real-world conditions outside the lab is planned, because that is not covered by the exclusion.
If the model is later commercialised or deployed, the classification must be redone.

obligations.text: No mandatory obligations apply. You may note the AI literacy duty and voluntary codes of conduct.

key_facts: The system only detects duplicate job applications.
A recruiter removes the duplicates.
It does not score, rank or evaluate candidates.
to_confirm: Confirm the system performs no profiling of natural persons, because profiling would make it high-risk regardless of the derogation.
Confirm the duplicate flag does not feed into any ranking, filtering or evaluation of candidates, and that a recruiter makes every removal decision.
Document the Art 6(3) assessment before placing the system on the market, because providers who rely on the derogation must record it.

rows.clarifying_question: What specifically does the AI do in your hiring process (for example ranking or filtering applications, scoring or evaluating candidates, targeting job ads, or only scheduling or drafting text), how is its output used, and who acts on it?

key_facts: AI chatbot on a careers page
It screens applicants
It decides who advances to interview
to_confirm: Whether a human reviews or can override the AI's interview-advancement decisions.
Whether you are the provider (built or branded the system) or a deployer using a third-party tool, since the obligations differ.
Whether the chatbot also interacts directly with candidates, which would add a duty to tell them they are talking to an AI.

obligations.text: Do not place on the market, put into service for this specific purpose, or use an AI system that predicts the risk of a person committing a criminal offence based solely on profiling or personality traits; the exception for supporting human assessment based on objective, verifiable facts directly linked to a criminal activity does not apply here.

key_facts: The system predicts how likely an individual is to commit a crime
It uses only personal traits and background
Police use it to decide who to watch
to_confirm: Confirm that no objective and verifiable facts directly linked to a criminal activity feed the system, and that it does not merely support a human assessment built on such facts.

obligations.text: No mandatory obligations apply, but providers and deployers should take measures to ensure sufficient AI literacy of their staff.

key_facts: AI grammar and spell-checker
Suggests fixes while the user types in a word processor
to_confirm: Confirm the tool only corrects or suggests edits and does not generate substantial new text or rewrite meaning; if it does, re-check the Art 50 transparency duties.
Confirm it is not marketed for a high-risk purpose, such as assessing candidates or students.

obligations.text: Do not use the real-time remote biometric identification system in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement, unless and in so far as the use is strictly necessary for a targeted search for victims or missing persons, preventing a specific imminent threat or terrorist attack, or locating a suspect of an Annex II offence punishable by at least four years' custody. Blanket scanning of people in public squares does not fall within these exceptions.

key_facts: The system does real-time facial recognition of people in public squares
The feed is streamed to the police
to_confirm: Whether any use is limited to one of the three narrow exceptions, targeting a specific individual, with the required authorisation under national law, a fundamental rights impact assessment and EU database registration.

obligations.text: Do not place on the market, put into service for this purpose, or use an AI system to infer employees' emotions in the workplace; the exception for medical or safety reasons does not apply to mood scoring in meetings.

key_facts: The tool reads employees' facial expressions during meetings
It scores employees' mood, which means inferring their emotions
It is used on employees in a workplace
to_confirm: Confirm that no genuine medical or safety purpose underlies the tool. Mood scoring for meetings or management would not qualify.
Confirm whether the tool is used only on employees or also elsewhere, for example with job candidates or in education settings.

Develop the system using training, validation and testing data sets that meet the data quality criteria.

key_facts: The AI assigns credit scores
The credit scores decide loan approvals
to_confirm: Confirm the system scores natural persons (consumers or individual applicants), not only businesses.
Confirm the system is not used solely to detect financial fraud, which is the only exception in Annex III point 5(b).

obligations.text: Do not place on the market, put into service for this specific purpose, or use this biometric categorisation system that infers race or religious beliefs from biometric data. The exceptions (labelling or filtering lawfully acquired biometric datasets, and categorising biometric data in law enforcement) do not apply to the described real-time inference of ethnicity and religion from faces.

key_facts: The tool does real-time biometric categorisation
It infers people's ethnicity and religion from their faces
to_confirm: Check whether the use is limited to labelling or filtering lawfully acquired biometric datasets, or to law enforcement. Neither is stated, so the exceptions are assumed not to apply.
